title: Tamper Seals and Case Screws on Returned PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Tamper Seals and Case Screws on Returned PAP Therapy Equipment

**Parts note.** A self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit returned to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request whose case was opened for warranty work takes new tamper seals and case screws, added to its reconditioning parts list at Summit Ridge list price:

| Manufacturer-warranty repairs on the device record | Tamper-seal part (USD) |
|---|---|
| two or more | 7.00 |
| exactly one | 3.50 |
| none | 0.00 |

**Where it is read.** The count is of the repair jobs in the device's service history whose cost was borne under the manufacturer warranty. Repair jobs whose cost was borne any other way are not counted.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- One manufacturer-warranty repair for a motor failure: 3.50.
- Two manufacturer-warranty repairs on the record: 7.00.
- One repair paid by the patient and no warranty repair: nothing.
